flows.name: An agent asks a question of the complete event record (Keewano)
flows.summary: Keewano's home page, in its five steps: raw events stay intact, are tied to entities and timelines, mapped to shared meaning, reasoned over beside the record, and answered to agents through standard interfaces.

steps.what: Ingests raw events from the existing stack (Kafka, Postgres, Snowflake, BigQuery, SDKs, Parquet or Iceberg) and keeps every event intact, in order, per entity.
Ties events to entities, timelines and outcomes, and maps raw event names to shared concepts (a semantic layer).
Asks a question through MCP (Keewano MCP for Agents), SQL, REST or an API.
Runs reports, sequence comparison or custom logic beside the record and answers, grounded in the events behind it.
